text: Arre yaar, kitni baar repeat karu? Pehle aapne kuch aur bola, ab aap phir se wahi same baat repeat kar rahe ho bina theek se sune. Mera dimag mat kharab karo, mujhe seedha batao ki replacement kab tak milega ya refund kab tak confirm hoga. Ek hafte se pareshan hoon main, please seedha baat karo na!
